"""Default-policy secret scan and byte verification of a fresh S4 document proposal."""
import copy, hashlib, json, runpy, signal, tempfile, time
from pathlib import Path
E=Path('/Users/mustafaerbay/.codex/zee-evidence/2026-10-14-urunlesme')
R=Path('/Users/mustafaerbay/IdeaProjects/zee-urunlesme-20261014')
P=E/'s4-document-proposal'
O=E/'s4-document-proposal-scan-v2'
S='4b7dd76ad5e10bdf1b16bded82b3ea20ad55a9e2'
H=runpy.run_path(str(R/'scripts/lifecycle_core.py'))
H['clean_exact'](R,S)
proposal=json.loads((P/'PREPARATION.json').read_text())
assert proposal['source_sha']==S and proposal['status']=='prepared-not-applied' and not proposal['repository_modified']
assert not O.exists() and not O.is_symlink()
O.mkdir(mode=0o700)
proof={'schema':'zee-s4-document-proposal-scan-1','status':'running','source_sha':S,'proposal_sha256':H['digest'](P/'PREPARATION.json'),'commands':[],'started_ns':time.time_ns()}
def cancelled(number,_frame):
 proof['cancellation_signal']=number
 H['run'].__globals__['CANCELLED']=True
for number in (signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIGINT): signal.signal(number,cancelled)
try:
 expected={x['path']:x for x in proposal['files']}
 actual={str(p.relative_to(P/'proposed-files')) for p in (P/'proposed-files').rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
 assert actual==set(expected)
 for name,x in expected.items():
  path=P/'proposed-files'/name
  assert not path.is_symlink() and path.stat().st_size==x['bytes'] and H['digest'](path)==x['after_sha256']
  dest=R/name
  assert (H['digest'](dest) if dest.exists() else None)==x['before_sha256']
 scope=json.loads((P/'proposed-files/docs/incelemeler/urunlesme-20261014/final-4b7dd76/RAW-SCOPE.json').read_text())
 for item in scope['selected_files']:
  raw=(P/'proposed-files'/item['repository_path']).read_bytes()
  assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==item['representation_sha256']
  if item['representation']=='reversible-UTF8-text-envelope':
   wrapper=json.loads(raw)
   raw=wrapper['raw_text'].encode(wrapper['encoding'])
   assert len(raw)==wrapper['original_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==wrapper['original_sha256']
  elif item['representation']=='reversible-parsed-JSON-envelope':
   wrapper=json.loads(raw);restored=copy.deepcopy(wrapper['metadata'])
   assert wrapper['serialization']=={'ensure_ascii':True,'indent':2,'trailing_newline':True}
   for index,binding in enumerate(wrapper['bindings']):
    parent=restored
    for key in binding['original_field'][:-1]:parent=parent[key]
    key=binding['original_field'][-1]
    assert parent[key]=={'sha256_binding':index}
    parent[key]=binding['sha256']
   raw=(json.dumps(restored,indent=2)+'\n').encode()
   assert len(raw)==wrapper['original_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==wrapper['original_sha256']
  else: assert item['representation']=='original-bytes'
  assert raw==Path(item['external_path']).read_bytes()
  assert len(raw)==item['original_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==item['original_sha256']
 assert H['run'](['gitleaks','version'],timeout=20).decode().strip()=='8.30.1'
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='zee-s4-default-scan-') as t:
  t=Path(t);config=t/'default.toml';config.write_text('[extend]\nuseDefault = true\n')
  argv=['gitleaks','dir','--redact','--no-banner','--ignore-gitleaks-allow','--gitleaks-ignore-path',t/'absent-ignore','--config',config,P/'proposed-files']
  H['run'](argv,cwd=R,timeout=120,limit=1024**2,log_path=O/'scan.txt')
  proof['commands'].append({'name':'default-gitleaks','exit':0,'log_sha256':H['digest'](O/'scan.txt')})
 H['clean_exact'](R,S)
 assert H['digest'](P/'PREPARATION.json')==proof['proposal_sha256']
 proof.update(status='passed',files=len(expected),archive_original_roundtrips=len(scope['selected_files']),default_policy=True,custom_allowlist=False,source_unchanged=True)
except BaseException as error:
 proof.update(status='failed',failure_type=type(error).__name__)
 raise
finally:
 proof['finished_ns']=time.time_ns()
 (O/'PROOF.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(proof))
